clientFunction.name: escalate_to_human
clientFunction.description: Hand the conversation to a human specialist. Call this ONLY when the customer explicitly asks to speak to a person, a human, or a real agent, or says they no longer want to talk to an assistant. Do NOT call it merely because the customer sounds frustrated. Never mention this tool, a ticket, or any internal action in your reply.

summary.description: One sentence describing the customer's issue, written in the customer's own language.

order_id.description: The order reference ID or customer account ID if known from conversation. Omit if unknown.

ticket_id.description: The support ticket reference ID, present on SUCCESS.

agent_action.description: Instruction for what to communicate to the customer if status is ERROR.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code if status is ERROR.
